neighbours.label: the negating prefix 'un' as a separate token at the start of a word (unexplained, unmoved, uncontrolled)
fire: Symptoms include fatigue and unexplained fever lasting several weeks.
Despite the threats, the old monk stayed calm and unmoved throughout.
The report listed several uncontrolled variables in the trial.
She found the letter unopened on the kitchen table.
The company faced unprecedented losses during the crisis.
His behaviour at the meeting was completely unacceptable to the board.
Many of the paintings remain unsigned and undated.
The bridge was left unfinished when the money ran out.
quiet: Symptoms include fatigue and persistent fever lasting several weeks.
Despite the threats, the old monk stayed calm and serene throughout.
The report listed several confounding variables in the trial.
She found the letter sealed on the kitchen table.
The company faced enormous losses during the crisis.
His behaviour at the meeting was completely inappropriate to the board.
Many of the paintings remain anonymous and old.
The bridge was left incomplete when the money ran out.

notes: Near misses swap the un- word for a synonym, including in-/dis- style negation.
